title: Programme Meal Allowance against a Departure Morning Breakfast
content:
A programme allowance is taken off where a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range is made under a corporate travel programme whose expense integration is included. It is read from the active programme in the Corporate Travel Programmes range the reservation is made under and from the hotel booking lines billed to that programme in the last twelve months.

Where that programme has expense integration included and the hotel booking lines billed to it in the last twelve months number 8 or more, the programme allowance is 20.00 USD. Where that programme has expense integration included and those lines number 3 or more but fewer than 8, the programme allowance is 10.00 USD. In every other case the programme allowance is nil.

Only lines billed as a hotel booking fee are counted, and lines posted more than twelve months before the closing breakfast charge is worked out are not counted. The figure is a count of lines, not their money total.

**Read as input, judgement and result, on hypothetical counts.**

> Input: an active programme with expense integration included, 8 hotel booking lines billed in the last twelve months.
> Judgement: 8 is not fewer than 8.
> Result: 20.00 USD.

> Input: the same programme with 7 such lines.
> Judgement: fewer than 8 but not fewer than 3.
> Result: 10.00 USD.

> Input: the same programme with 3 such lines.
> Judgement: 3 is the foot of the middle band.
> Result: 10.00 USD.

> Input: the same programme with 2 such lines.
> Judgement: fewer than 3.
> Result: Nil.

> Input: an active programme with 11 hotel booking lines billed but expense integration not included.
> Judgement: the condition on expense integration is not met.
> Result: Nil.

> Input: a reservation made under no active programme.
> Judgement: there is no programme whose expense integration could be included.
> Result: Nil.
